Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro hanbok-style set of ultra-thin soft-pink silk charmeuse, a tiny cropped jeogori jacket with short sleeves ending right under her bust, the two lapels crossing in a V over her bust and fastened by a long ribbon goreum tied in a bow in front, her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro chima wrap skirt of the same silk charmeuse tied low at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the silk charmeuse shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin silk charmeuse molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the long ribbon goreum falling in front and the crossing lapels sitting crisp against her skin, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. Background: a blooming lavender field in neat rows under a clear sky with a gravel path, a wooden gate and fence of normal height, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
